title: fix(plugin-timeline): forward only named DOM attributes onto the timeline root (objectui#10841)
body:
Fixes #10841
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`TimelineRenderer` (`packages/plugin-timeline/src/renderer.tsx`) collected every prop it did not name into `...props` and spread the bag onto the root element of each variant: the `Timeline` rail, the grouped vertical `div`, `TimelineHorizontal` and `TimelineGantt`. Created through `SchemaRenderer` as `plugin-timeline:timeline`, that bag holds every node key left after `SchemaRenderer` strips its metadata keys. So the DOM carried `items="[object Object]"` and the other authored keys as attributes.

The four roots now take the converged route, the `container.tsx` / `header-bar.tsx` shape pinned by `header-bar-root-dom-props-10496.test.tsx`: `{...toDomProps(hostProps)}` with `style` forwarded by name. `toDomProps` is the SDUI widget contract's DOM pass-through that `@object-ui/core` executes (`packages/core/src/utils/dom-props.ts`, the objectui#4425 phase-2 ruling), and that file owns the set and the reason for each member. There is no renderer-private list; `TimelineRenderer`'s docblock points at `dom-props.ts`. The prop type annotation is unchanged.

**Round 2 (contract review `5860492112` on `ebe3742cf`).** The first pass filtered through a module-private `ROOT_DOM_ATTRIBUTES` / `rootDomProps`. That was a third judge of this contract, and it drifted from it: it silently dropped `tabIndex`, `autoFocus` and the `onClick` / `onBlur` / `onFocus` handlers the contract forwards. That list is deleted. The pin now imports `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS` for its allowed-attribute set, and it gains a `tabIndex` control on every variant.

## Caller survey (objectui `origin/main` at `4aebea00a`)

| Caller | How it reaches `TimelineRenderer` | What it passes besides `schema` / `className` | After this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugin-timeline:timeline` registration, via `SchemaRenderer`'s `createElement` | registry lookup by the namespaced key | every node key the metadata strip leaves (`items`, `variant`, `dateFormat`, `scale`, `rowLabel`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `id`, `style`, `role`, `tabIndex`, `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescribedBy`, `name`, `label`, and any undeclared key such as `title`); the legacy `props` bag; `aria-label` / `aria-describedby` / `role` from `resolveAriaProps`; `data-debug-type` / `data-debug-id` in debug mode; `disabled` (set only on a disabled node); `data-obj-id` / `data-obj-type`; `data-testid` when `testId` is authored; `data-obj-schema-invalid` in dev on an invalid node; and any host prop handed to `SchemaRenderer` | `toDomProps` keeps what the SDUI contract forwards and `style` goes by name; the rest is dropped |
| `ObjectTimeline`, via `effectiveSchema` | direct JSX, `TimelineRenderer schema={effectiveSchema}` | nothing | unchanged; this is the control below |
| Any other importer of the public `TimelineRenderer` export | `git grep` across `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/` | none outside `packages/plugin-timeline`; inside it, only tests, each passing `schema` alone | n/a |

`SchemaRenderer` strips `type`, `children`, `body`, `schema`, the visibility and disabled predicate keys, `dataSource`, `testId`, `objectFields`, `_hidden`, `_disabled` and `responsiveStyles` before its spread.

**Dropped by the contract, and no longer on the root:**
- every authored schema key;
- the `disabled` attribute a disabled node used to put on the `ol` / `div` root. It had no effect there, and nothing in the repo reads `[disabled]` on the timeline root;
- `name` / `label`, which `BaseSchema` declares but which have no effect on an `ol` / `div`;
- an authored `title`, which neither `BaseSchema` nor `TimelineSchema` declares. It is a global HTML attribute, so dropping it removes the native tooltip it used to put on the root.

No in-repo author writes any of those four on a `plugin-timeline:timeline` node. **Kept beyond the triage's list:** `role`, a member of `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS` and emitted by `resolveAriaProps`, and `tabIndex` plus the host event handlers the contract forwards.

## Measured: root attributes, one authored node per variant (real `SchemaRenderer` + registry)

| Variant | Base `4aebea00a` | This PR `6482341e7` |
|---|---|---|
| vertical, flat (`OL`) | `id`, `arialabel`, `role`, `style`, `variant`, `dateformat`, `items="[object Object]"`, `aria-label`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` | `id`, `role`, `style`, `aria-label`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` |
| vertical, grouped (`DIV`) | `id`, `variant`, `dateformat`, `items="[object Object]"`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` | `id`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` |
| horizontal (`DIV`) | `id`, `variant`, `dateformat`, `items="[object Object]"`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` | `id`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` |
| gantt (`DIV`) | `id`, `variant`, `dateformat`, `scale`, `rowlabel`, `mindate`, `maxdate`, `items="[object Object]"`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` | `id`, `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `data-testid` |
| disabled node with `title` / `name` / `label` / `ariaDescribedBy` | `variant`, `name`, `label`, `title`, `ariadescribedby`, `items`, `aria-describedby`, `disabled`, `data-obj-type` | `aria-describedby`, `data-obj-type` |
| `tabIndex: 0`, plus a host `onClick` handed to `SchemaRenderer` | (not re-measured here; the review measured `tabindex="0"` on base) | `tabindex`, `data-obj-type`; the host `onClick` fires on a root click (1 call) |
| control: bare `timeline` (`view:timeline`, through `ObjectTimeline`) | rail `OL` carries `class` only | rail `OL` carries `class` only |

`class` is on every root and is omitted above. **React DOM-prop warnings:** 6 on base in the first probe (`ariaLabel`, `dateFormat`, `rowLabel`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `ariaDescribedBy`), and 0 at `6482341e7`. React reports each prop name once per module, so 6 is a floor. The lowercase keys (`items`, `variant`, `scale`) never warn; they just land. No existing package test rendered the leaking route: the package's `SchemaRenderer`-driven tests all use `object-timeline` or the bare `timeline`, and `plugin-timeline:timeline` appears only in registry-metadata tests.

## Tests (all at head `6482341e7`)

- **Pin** `packages/plugin-timeline/src/__tests__/timeline-root-dom-props-10841.test.tsx`: one authored node per variant (flat vertical, grouped vertical, horizontal, gantt) through the real `SchemaRenderer`, plus the bare-`timeline` control, whose rail carries `class` only.
  - Each variant asserts that `items` and `variant` are absent by name, and that no other key the node authors appears as a lowercase attribute.
  - Every root attribute must be `class`, `style`, a key of `SDUI_DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS` (imported from `@object-ui/core`, so the pin is not a third copy) or `data-*` / `aria-*`. React must emit no DOM-prop warning.
  - Controls: `data-testid` from `testId`, `tabindex` from `tabIndex`, `id`, `data-obj-id` / `data-obj-type`, and on the vertical case `aria-label` / `role` / `style`.
  - Result: `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- **Ablations.** Each leg runs `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with anchor `{...toDomProps(hostProps)}` expected 4 times. Each leg was committed first and restored to blob `cc4cf9f1b115` == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - **Spread restored** (`{...hostProps}`): landed 4 to 0. `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`, first failure `root carries items="[object Object]"`.
  - **Bag dropped** (an empty-object spread): landed 4 to 0. `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`, failing on `the authored testId no longer reaches the root: expected null to be 'rail-vertical-tid'`.
  - **First-pass allowlist reproduced** (a filter keeping `id`, `role`, `data-*` and `aria-*`, with `style` still by name): landed 4 to 0. `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`, each failing on `the contract key tabIndex no longer reaches the root: expected null to be '0'`. So the new control catches the drift the review found.
  - The control case stays green in every leg, as expected.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-timeline/`: `Test Files 33 passed (33)`, `Tests 355 passed (355)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-timeline^...'`, 10/10 cached).
- In-repo consumers of `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`: `apps/console` `timelineAxisRefusalReach-7070`, `pullToRefreshOwner-10105` and `filterContextTokensSweep-10666`, plus `examples/schema-catalog` `catalog-gallery-render`. Result `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 672 passed (672)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5314 passed | 2 skipped`. Run whole, because a package-scoped run does not reach `scripts/__tests__`.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check-control-bytes` (9089 tracked files), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-shell-escape-residue`.
- Lint, narrowed to the one package that holds the source edits. `eslint . --no-inline-config` from `packages/plugin-timeline` under the root flat config (no package config exists). That is the unit `pnpm lint` (`turbo run lint`) runs for this package. JSON output: 39 files, 0 errors, and the pin 0 errors / 0 warnings. The config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`. Both need a full workspace / console build, and both stop at that prerequisite. This diff edits no README and changes no export or registration.

## Acceptance notes

- **`widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` is not widened here.** Its target set is the four packages objectui#4425 named plus the `packages/components` family objectui#5574 added. Its migration convention is per-package cards deleting their own ledger rows, and its docblock keeps widening separate from fixing ("Widening the gate and fixing what it catches are separable"). Adding `plugin-timeline:` would be that kind of widening. It needs `@object-ui/plugin-timeline` as an `app-shell` devDependency (it is not one today), a `view:timeline` entry in `OWNED_VIEW_ALIASES`, and the docblock counts that section 6 asserts. Until then, the per-variant pin above is the guard for this target.
- On the `view:timeline` route (bare `timeline`), no element carries `SchemaRenderer`'s `data-obj-id` / `data-obj-type` or an authored `testId`'s `data-testid`. `ObjectTimelineRenderer` hands them to `ObjectTimeline`, which does not forward them. `BaseSchema.testId`'s declaration already carves this out ("A renderer that drops unknown props drops this one too"), so it is not filed. Unchanged here.
- The gantt refusal surfaces (the `role="alert"` divs) never received the root props and still do not. Unchanged.
- The grouped vertical branch runs only when items carry `group`, which objectui#6356 ruled renderer-internal. The pin authors that off-spec key on purpose: it is the only way to hand that branch `SchemaRenderer`'s prop bag. The comment above the pin says so.
